portInfo.description: Spetses is a tender call under the Municipal Port Fund of Spetses. Reporting ahead of the 2026 season states Poseidonio becomes the main cruise passenger landing to relieve Dapia, with Dapia retained for exceptional cases such as weather. Always follow the ship’s tender instructions over press summaries.
